reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 19.1 gives a professional/workmanlike services warranty against industry standards, § 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformity warranty (measured from the later of delivery or acceptance, i.e. more favourable than the preferred position's delivery trigger) plus hosted Services conformity for the whole subscription term (3 years under § 8.1, exceeding the 12-month software benchmark).

Remedy requirement is satisfied: § 19.4 provides prompt re-performance/repair/replacement at no charge with escalation to termination and refund of Fees, and is expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
Compliance-with-law and no-malicious-code warranties are present in § 19.3; the 'intentionally introduced by Vendor' qualifier is a common market limitation and does not defeat the position.

The disclaimer does not swallow the express warranties: § 19.5 disclaims only implied warranties and expressly states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy.

No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding, and none was proposed; the deterministic period check passes, so the rationale's reference to a 'failed period check' is a harmless inconsistency that does not affect the substance.
